author: Inside Edition
description: High school soccer star Karoline Heintz had a bright future, as the Pennsylvania teen was just about to start her freshman year at PennWest University. Now she's dead, after cops say her boyfriend, Royce Mosher, stabbed her with a large kitchen knife. He's not the only one under arrest; his mother, Rachel Mosher, is also in cuffs, charged with trying to cover up a crime, an allegation that she denies. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian has the latest.
title: Teen Kills Soccer Star Girlfriend As His Mom Helps Cover Up Crime: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: People are still talking about Prince Harry and Meghan Markle leaving the US to go back to the UK. While Harry's future with his royal family is uncertain, People magazine reports that Meghan is planning to return to her old career as an actress. As Inside Edition's Alison Hall reports, she may make her big comeback on a hit Netflix show. Meanwhile, Madame Tussauds is having some fun with their Meghan and Harry display.
title: Will Meghan Markle Be Returning To Acting With This Hit Netflix Show?

author: Inside Edition
description: The Linsday Clancy case is shining a light on postpartum issues for women. That's something Hayden Panetierre struggled with after the birth of her daughter. After the late actress went  public with her post-baby mental health issues a little over a decade ago, Neutrogena dropped her as a brand ambassador. In the wake of Panetierre's death, the popular skin health and beauty brand said that was a mistake.
title: Neutrogena Says It Was A Mistake To Drop Hayden Panetierre As Brand Ambassador

author: Inside Edition
description: It's no secret in Washington how devoted 35-year-old Natalie Harp is to her boss, President Donald Trump. But recently surfaced letters she reportedly wrote to the chief executive during a 2023 trip to Scotland show just how deep her loyalty goes. Executive assistant Harp refers to Trump as her "guardian and protector." Inside Edition's Justin Finch tells us what else Harp's notes to the president say.
title: What Did Natalie Harp Say In Her Letters To Donald Trump?

author: Inside Edition
description: Imagine going out for a drive and having a barefooted man jump on your car! It happened to Tonya Neff, who bolted from her Honda Civic and ran to safety. The unsettling incident happened in the Bellevue neighborhood of Nashville, Tennessee, and was caught on home surveillance cameras. Police later arrested a 45-year-old suspect nearby, and he faces a litany of charges, including vandalism and disorderly conduct.
title: Barefoot Man Jumps On Woman's Car

author: Inside Edition
description: A terrifying moment was caught on video, as a woman was swarmed by hundreds of killer bees at a Texas storage facility. Rachel McKee was stung hundreds of times before being rushed to the hospital. The hospital reported it was the most stings they'd ever seen. Thankfully, she didn't experience an allergic reaction to the stings. Rachel spoke with Inside Edition's Justin Finch about her scary and painful experience.
title: Woman Stung Hundreds Of Times By Bees At Storage Facility
